title: Compact mosaic onboarding + pricing illustration set for model lifecycle release notes
creator: Ava Turner
description: Create a compact 'mosaic' pack of onboarding and release-note visuals for the model catalog that clearly communicates: (1) new model launches with performance callouts, (2) model deprecation notices with migration guidance, and (3) pricing overlays at multiple sizes. Deliverables should be optimized for release notes (banner + narrow column), Console release modal (card-level thumbnails), and doc quickstart inserts. Focus on: concise visual hierarchy, clear deprecation affordances (ribbons, dates), accessible color contrast for price badges, and localized currency support. Avoid reusing existing catalog hero layouts; emphasize compact, grid-first compositions that scale down to 240px wide cards.
acceptance_criteria: 3 tile sizes exported: banner (1200x360), card (480x320), compact (240x160)
Pricing overlays include USD, EUR, JPY variants and a 1px stroke for legibility on dark tiles
Deprecation ribbon variants: upcoming (yellow), deprecated (red) with tooltip copy placeholder
All PNG/JPEG exports with 2x retina equivalents and SVG source provided in Figma file
